name: OCR Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，OCR Group Berhad 完成出售位于 Shah Alam 的约4.58英亩开发用地，并推进以发行新股方式收购 Chester Properties Sdn Bhd 49% 股权的交易，后者于7月签署有条件买卖协议。同期公司未公告新的建筑或项目管理合约。
overview_en: In 2026, OCR Group Berhad completed the disposal of approximately 4.58 acres of development land in Shah Alam and progressed its proposed acquisition of a 49% equity interest in Chester Properties Sdn Bhd, to be satisfied via issuance of new shares, with a conditional sale and purchase agreement signed in July. No new construction or project management contracts were announced during the year.

segments.name: 产业发展
segments.note: 今年完成出售 Shah Alam 一幅约4.58英亩开发用地，并推进收购 Chester Properties 49% 股权。
segments.note_en: Completed the disposal of approximately 4.58 acres of development land in Shah Alam and progressed the proposed acquisition of a 49% stake in Chester Properties.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述出售于2026年7月23日完成，公司已收到全部净代价及支出。
actions.text_en: The disposal was completed on 23 July 2026, with the Company having received the full net consideration and outgoings.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Dato' Howard 签署有条件股权买卖协议，以 RM19.60 million 收购 Chester Properties 49% 股权，通过按每股 RM0.041 发行 478,048,780 股新股支付。
actions.text_en: Entered into a conditional share sale agreement with Dato' Howard to acquire a 49% equity interest in Chester Properties for RM19.60 million, satisfied via the issuance of 478,048,780 new shares at RM0.041 per share.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方同意将意向协议到期日延长2个月，从2026年6月4日延至2026年8月4日，以敲定最终协议条款。
actions.text_en: Both parties agreed to extend the HOA expiry date by 2 months from 4 June 2026 to 4 August 2026 to finalise the terms of the definitive agreement.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Dato' Howard Chew Si Hoo 签署意向协议，拟收购 Chester Properties Sdn Bhd 49% 股权，代价将全部以发行 OCR 新股支付。
actions.text_en: Entered into a heads of agreement with Dato' Howard Chew Si Hoo for the proposed acquisition of a 49% equity interest in Chester Properties Sdn Bhd, to be satisfied entirely via issuance of new OCR shares.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 OCR Avenue Sdn. Bhd. 与 Magna Ecocity Sdn. Bhd. 及 Twinicon (M) Sdn. Bhd. 签署买卖协议，出售 Shah Alam 约4.58英亩开发用地。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary OCR Avenue Sdn. Bhd. entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Magna Ecocity Sdn. Bhd. and Twinicon (M) Sdn. Bhd.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过出售 Shah Alam 约4.58英亩开发用地，退出该地块的产业发展项目。
model_changes.text_en: Exited the property development project on the approximately 4.58-acre land in Shah Alam through the disposal of the land.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟以发行新股方式收购 Chester Properties 49% 股权，将业务延伸至该公司的房地产相关业务。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed acquisition of a 49% equity interest in Chester Properties via issuance of new shares, extending its business into Chester Properties' real estate-related operations.
